run.name: Alkermes plc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (ALKS)
run.summary: Alkermes looks serviceable on its secured term loans today, with 787.6 US$m of cash and investments and 3.40 times leverage on Adjusted EBITDA, but depends on managing VIVITROL generic entry expected in 2027. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, company definition, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Carrying debt 1,497.7 US$m and net debt 710.2 US$m over LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 440.2 US$m (management definition, FY2025 portion derived). On reported EBITDA of 146.2 US$m the ratios are 10.25x and 4.86x. Not a covenant ratio; covenant definitions Not supplied

cash.basis: Cash. Cash and cash equivalents only; short-term investments 124.2 and long-term investments 32.1 US$m are excluded, giving 787.6 US$m in total

cashflow.basis: Cash from operations, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, cash interest and ownership are not in the sources, and leverage rests on management add-backs.
CP-1 main limitation: Covenant levels, cash interest and a revolver are not in the sources, and FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA is derived.
